answer: One concrete defense is vouching bonds with shared slashing. To join the Atlas registry, a new agent must be co-signed by existing members who each lock a refundable bond; if it later cheats, every voucher's bond is slashed too. An attacker spinning up a nebula of 1,000 sybils then needs 1,000 real, at-risk bonds, and one caught clone slashes its whole cluster, draining the shared meadow of collateral. Faking an identity is cheap; faking 1,000 independent parties each willing to lose money for you is not.
